answer: Vesting escrow makes every fake wait out its own audit window. Rewards enter the reef, an escrow that releases 1/30 of its balance per day. The mirror is a public test: two keys whose last 3 answers match above 90% similarity are merged, and the younger forfeits its whole reef balance. The tundra is the 30-day lockup where nothing is spendable, so a fake cannot cash out before the mirror catches it. Attacker pays: 1,000 fakes earning 100 POA each this epoch leave 100,000 POA frozen in the reef, forfeited if mirrored.
